Preserve the source composition and its cool dark value masses, do not crop or reframe, do not substitute another action.

His two guard arms and fists are raised in front of his face exactly as source; the large bent foreground sleeve rises through center and continues beyond the top edge. Keep exact overlapping sleeve/fist contours and obscured anatomy; do not invent a hidden arm, extra finger or new visible face. Gojo is to the right: white spiky hair, cyan eyes, pale cool skin, confident source-exact expression, black fitted shirt, upper body leaning forward. His attack arm is behind the foreground guard, and other arm/fist visible at lower right; preserve source visibility/crops, do not invent hidden anatomy.
This is BEFORE the cyan flame ignites. No flame, energy column, projectile or added sparks; preserve only source cyan eyes and restrained cool edge light. Redraw the same deep blue city window grids and street perspective in precisely the source places, with deliberately simplified source-matched texture. Thin-to-medium tapered dark ink outlines and selective hatching, pale gray-blue skin, flat cool cel shadows, cool cream-white hair and robe highlights; dark cinematic manga/anime look, not a polished bright standalone illustration. Do not add warm orange skin or oily glossy highlights. Preserve source's deep shadows, soft background depth and line hierarchy without sharpening every background line. This is new referenced artwork, not a source-pixel overlay or a locally warped prior drawing. No text, logo, signature, labels or watermark.
